content.text: I'll query the EHR database to calculate SSRI discontinuation proportions for new users over 6 months. Let me build an appropriate SQL query using OMOP standard concepts.

arguments.sql_query:
-- Step 1: Look up all SSRI drug concept IDs and their hierarchies
WITH ssri_concepts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT descendant.concept_id,
           descendant.concept_name
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN omop.concept descendant ON ca.descendant_concept_id = descendant.concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept ancestor ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ancestor.concept_id
    WHERE ancestor.concept_class_id IN ('Ingredient', 'Clinical Filter')
      AND ancestor.domain_id = 'Drug'
      AND ancestor.standard_concept = 'S'
      AND ancestor.vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
      AND LOWER(descendant.concept_name) IN (
          'sertraline',
          'fluoxetine',
          'citalopram',
          'escitalopram oxalate',
          'escitalopram',
          'paroxetine',
          'paroxetine hydrochloride',
          'fluvoxamine',
          'fluvoxamine maleate',
          'fluvoxamine maleate sr'
      )
),

-- Step 2: Identify all SSRI exposures and compute runs (days of continuous coverage)
ssri_exposures AS (
    SELECT de.person_id,
           de.drug_concept_id,
           de.drug_source_value,
           de.start_date,
           de.end_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.person_id ORDER BY de.start_date) as rn
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN ssri_concepts sc ON de.drug_concept_id = sc.concept_id
),

-- Step 3: For each person, find their first-ever SSRI exposure = new use index date
new_ssri_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT person_id,
           drug_concept_id,
           start_date as index_date,
           MAX(drug_concept_id) OVER (PARTITION BY person_id)
    FROM ssri_exposures se
),

-- Step 4: Compute continuous therapy duration for each exposure within SSRIs
exposure_gaps AS (
    SELECT de.person_id,
           de.drug_concept_id,
           de.start_date,
           de.end_date,
           LEAD(de.start_date) OVER (
               PARTITION BY de.person_id ORDER BY de.start_date
           ) - de.end_date as gap_days,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.person_id ORDER BY de.start_date) as exp_rn
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN ssri_concepts sc ON de.drug_concept_id = sc.concept_id
),

-- Step 5: Compute continuous treatment runs by merging overlapping/nearby exposures (gap <= 90 days = continuation)
continuous_runs AS (
    SELECT person_id,
           drug_concept_id,
           exp_rn,
           start_date,
           end_date,
           gap_days,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(gap_days, 3650) > 91 THEN 'new_course' ELSE 'continue' END as course_break
    FROM exposure_gaps
),

-- Step 6: For new users, define discontinuation = no refill within 90 days after final exposure
-- (standard: gap > 90 days from last fill without subsequent fill within observation window)
new_user_discontinuation AS (
    SELECT nu.person_id,
           sc.concept_name as drug_class,
           nu.start_date as first_ssri_date,
           obs.observation_period_end_date,
           obs.observation_period_start_date,
           nu.drug_concept_id,
           -- Max days of coverage from index (capped at 180 = 6 months)
           LEAST(
               DATEDIFF(day,
                   nu.start_date,
                   COALESCE(MAX(e.end_date),
                       ADDDATE(nu.start_date, 90))
               ),
               180
           ) as days_with_coverage_capped_180,
           -- Whether they had any gap > 90 days indicating discontinuation
           MAX(CASE WHEN COALESCE(gap_days, 3650) > 'DISCONTINUED' ELSE 'CONTINUED' END as discontinuation_status
    FROM ssri_concepts sc
    JOIN omop.observation_period obs ON nu.person_id = obs.person_id
    ON nu.drug_concept_id = sc.concept_id
        LEFT JOIN exposure_gaps e ON nu.person_id = e.person_id AND e.start_date >= nu.start_date
        AND NOT(e.gap_days IS NOT NULL)
        WHERE nu.start_date BETWEEN obs.observation_period_start_date
            AND DATE_SUB(obs.observation_period_end_date, INTERVAL 180 DAY)
),

-- Step 7: Final count - proportion who discontinued (gap > 90 days indicates discontinuation)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) as total_new_ssri_users_included,
    SUM(CASE WHEN days_with_coverage_capped_180 < 181 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) as discontinuation_proportion_6mo,
    AVG(days_with_coverage_capped_180) as mean_days_of_coverage_within_6mo,
    MIN(days_with_coverage_capped_180) as min_days_of_coverage,
    MAX(days_with_coverage_capped_180) as max_days_of_coverage
FROM new_user_discontinuation;
